tasks.short: Coordinate nurses, technicians and other care providers

steps.what: Review current perioperative responsibilities and the patient's immediate care needs
Determine the responsibilities, supervision and escalation needed for the care team
Direct and coordinate nurses, medical technicians and other providers and confirm understanding
outputs: understood care directions and agreed responsibilities

steps.what: Record and confirm actual team directions, responsibilities and escalation arrangements
inputs: understood care directions and agreed responsibilities

steps.what: Save the approved coordination note in the current perioperative record

tasks.design: Retain live team direction and supervision, supported by the existing {OTHER} perioperative record. Record the actual responsibilities separately; existing templates do not by themselves reduce the required clinical coordination or factual capture.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coordination depends on current patient and team conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared records support the work, but no new labour reduction is established.
tasks.still_hard: Adapt responsibilities and supervision to changing care needs.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: perioperative coordination combines live clinical direction with a factual record of responsibilities.

assumptions: Boundary includes the anesthesiologist's whole coordination participation and its note; no record write is hidden in conversation. Other providers' unchanged time is not claimed as focal saving.

Existing care-plan and team-status producers supply current patient/task references and responsibilities. s4 counts capture of actual directions, role, time, limits and escalation from s3. Missing facts require direct confirmation, not inferred assignments.
Native task views and note templates are considered first. No duplicate entry or concrete capture reduction is established; clinical discussion and factual note writing remain at 100%.
Same-record save is effectively zero; minimum 1 earns no saving. Approval follows final note creation. Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0, independent of means priors.
unknowns: Whether a separate duplicate coordination record exists
research_questions: Observe team direction and trace its actual note before proposing automation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Live coordination, review and note capture are explicit; no verified mechanism changes their labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer on the type and method of anesthesia or sedation

steps.what: Review the relevant patient history, planned procedure and existing preoperative findings
inputs: existing patient record and preoperative findings

steps.what: Confer with other medical professionals about the anesthetic or sedation options and patient constraints
Determine the type and method of anesthetic or sedation
Record and approve the chosen approach and the discussion's unresolved concerns
Save the approved discussion note in the current patient record

tasks.design: Configure a native preoperative view in {OTHER}, the clinical record, to bring existing findings and procedure details together. The anesthesiologist retains the consultation, selection of approach and actual decision note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant preoperative information may span record sections.
tasks.enabler_now: Native encounter views can reduce a small amount of navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Determine an appropriate approach from patient and procedure context.
tasks.human_edge: Integrate specialist judgement and accept the clinical choice.

ambition.what: Reduce preparatory navigation without delegating the clinical discussion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: encounter views can organize existing preoperative information without choosing an anesthetic approach.

assumptions: Boundary includes the consultation, choice and its note, not ordering or administering anesthesia.

Existing clinicians supply history, findings, dates, provenance and procedure ID in the record. The view reads those fields; missing information requires normal enquiry in s1/s2. s4 counts actual approach and rationale capture.
Native views come first. Central removes only 10% of preparation navigation; all interpretation, consultation and writing remain. If the view already exists, there is no new saving.
Same-record save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained. Approval follows the completed note. Provisional B=100, R=98, gross=2; focal upkeep=0.5; net=1.5, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Observe preparation separately from clinical interpretation and discussion.

already_counted.description: Review actual preoperative findings and resolve missing context

incremental.description: Check view omissions after record configuration changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native preoperative views already suffice. High: two gross points face 0.5 extra source checks and 0.5 upkeep hours, leaving one.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage anesthesia services and formulate plans and procedures

steps.what: Formulate service priorities and proposed plan or procedure changes
inputs: existing anesthesia service activity and incident findings
current approved procedures and clinical requirements
outputs: proposed service priorities and procedure-change intent

steps.what: Coordinate anesthesia service plans with surgery, recovery and other medical activities
inputs: proposed service priorities and procedure-change intent
other services' operational and clinical constraints
outputs: agreed service arrangements and unresolved conflicts

steps.what: Capture the selected plan, procedure actions, responsibilities and explicit limits
inputs: agreed service arrangements and unresolved conflicts
proposed service priorities and procedure-change intent
outputs: clinician-defined service plan and procedure content

steps.what: Compose the service plan and procedure document from the clinician-defined content
inputs: clinician-defined service plan and procedure content
current approved procedures and clinical requirements

loop.purpose: Compose clear service documentation from selected content
loop.input: Clinician-defined actions, prerequisites, limits, responsibilities and approved source text
loop.output: Source-linked document draft with no new clinical actions
loop.check: Anesthesiologist checks sequence, exceptions, clinical intent, responsibilities and consistency with other service arrangements
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; incomplete clinical content returns to manual formulation
loop.why_not_simpler: Coordination rationale and procedure explanations are narrative; deterministic templates handle fixed sections first

steps.what: Validate and approve the final service plan and procedure document
inputs: clinician-defined service plan and procedure content

steps.what: Save the approved service document in its current controlled workspace

tasks.design: Use bounded composition in {DOCS} after the anesthesiologist has formulated and coordinated the service changes and captured their exact content. The anesthesiologist verifies the completed plan and procedures; the drafting tool neither selects clinical actions nor publishes a procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Formulated service changes still need coherent written procedures and rationale.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound composition can assist this writing after clinical choices exist.
tasks.still_hard: Formulate workable procedures across interdependent medical services.
tasks.human_edge: Accept clinical intent and resolve service constraints.

ambition.what: Reduce document composition around retained service management.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded drafting can compose service documentation from explicit human-selected content, with substantive review.

assumptions: Boundary includes service management, coordination, formulation and writing. Institutional ratification or release, where required, is separate and not assumed to disappear.

Existing service owners supply activity and incident records and current procedure versions. s3 counts capture of exact actions, sequence, prerequisites, roles, timing, exceptions and limits chosen in s1/s2. Missing clinical content returns to the clinician; the model may not complete it.
Native controlled-document templates come first. Central removes half of composition effort only, retaining all formulation, coordination, capture and final review.
Same-workspace save is effectively zero; minimum 1 earns no saving. Approval follows final revisions and edits void it.
Provisional B=100, R=90, gross=10; focal upkeep=1; net=9, independent of means priors.
unknowns: Composition effort and native template coverage
research_questions: Compare drafts to clinician-defined content and time all substantive revisions.

already_counted.description: Verify final procedure intent, exceptions and service consistency

incremental.description: Audit drafting fidelity and current source versions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: existing templates already cover composition. High: ten gross points require three extra substantive revision hours and one upkeep hour, leaving six.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Determine the indicated laboratory tests, x-rays or other diagnostic procedures
inputs: existing clinical results and procedure context

steps.what: Locate the exact selected test or procedure in the order catalogue
Prepare the diagnostic order with patient, timing and clinician-specified details
Review and approve the final diagnostic order and destination
outputs: approved diagnostic order v1 with destination

steps.what: Submit the approved order to the diagnostic service through the current order system
inputs: approved diagnostic order v1 with destination

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue shortcuts and encounter defaults in {OTHER}, the clinical ordering system, for tests the anesthesiologist has already chosen. Keep indication, variable order details and final review with the clinician before a separate gated submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Catalogue navigation and repeated encounter fields may add clerical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native favourites and validated encounter defaults can assist supported order preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Choose the appropriate diagnostic procedure and patient-specific requirements.

ambition.what: Reduce supported clerical ordering work without automating test selection.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical order catalogues can use favourites and encounter defaults while clinicians retain test selection and authorization.

assumptions: Boundary is choosing and submitting diagnostic orders, not performing tests or interpreting their results.

Existing registration supplies patient/encounter ID and service routing; catalogue owners maintain exact test codes and requirements. s1 counts clinical selection; s3 counts entering actual indication, timing, specimen/site and other required variable details. Missing fields remain manual. Defaults never infer the indicated test.

Native capabilities come first. Central requires real current navigation and repeated-field entry; it reduces s2 by 30% and s3 by 40% only. If current ordering already provides these features, claim no incremental saving.
Current-system submission takes approximately zero time; minimum 1 is retained and earns nothing. The completed order and destination are approved before submission; edits void approval.
Provisional B=100, R=85.5, gross=14.5; focal upkeep=0.5; net=14, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Observe diagnostic orders and separate clinical selection, clerical entry and final authorization time.

already_counted.description: Review exact diagnostic order and destination

incremental.description: Review changed catalogue shortcuts and encounter defaults

approvals.approved_version: approved diagnostic order v1 with destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native order defaults and favourites are already configured. High: 14.5 gross points require four extra default/catalogue checks and 0.5 upkeep hours, leaving ten.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Anesthesiologists retain clinical choice, supervision and service coordination while native ordering and bounded document composition assist clerical work.
reach: Clinical information team: validate encounter defaults
skills_to_grow: Separate clinical judgement from clerical preparation
role.ambitious_version: An anesthesiologist supported by reliable records and ordering tools who retains responsibility for clinical choices and coordinated care.
